actors.name: Manuel Adorni
actors.blurb: Manuel Adorni is currently at the center of a major scandal in Argentina after admitting to omitting $500,000 in undeclared savings and cryptocurrency investments in his sworn asset declarations. This revelation has led to widespread calls for his resignation from both opposition parties and allies within the ruling coalition, La Libertad Avanza. The scandal has significantly impacted the government's credibility and sparked debates over corruption and transparency in public office.

actors.name: Giorgia Meloni
actors.blurb: Giorgia Meloni continues to shape the news cycle with her domestic and international policies.
